groups.name: UAE
groups.tagline: 10 Nights, 11 Days · Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al-Khaimah, Sharjah, Qasr al Sarab, Babal Shams

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Ras Al-Khaimah, Sharjah, Qasr al Sarab, Babal Shams at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Middle East journeys we shape by hand through Middle East, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Rise above the city at Burj Khalifa, explore Dubai Mall and enjoy the mesmerising Dubai Fountain beside Burj Lake.
Admire the serene Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, explore the artistic world of Louvre Abu Dhabi and enjoy the Corniche's graceful waterfront views.
Escape into rugged beauty with Jebel Jais, dramatic mountain views, desert landscapes and pristine beaches.
Immerse yourself in art, culture and heritage through Al Noor Island, waterfront promenades and historic souks.
Retreat into the Liwa Desert, where an Arabian-fortress setting rises among endless orange dunes and golden silence.
Savor an elegant desert escape with traditional Arabian architecture, tranquil pools, starlit dining and immersive desert experiences.

groups.name: Turkey
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, Byzantium, Antalya

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Istanbul, Cappadocia, Pamukkale, Byzantium, Antalya at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Turkey journeys we shape by hand through Turkey, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Discover Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, Topkapı Palace and the Bosphorus in a city where Europe and Asia meet.
Rise above fairy chimneys in a sunrise hot-air balloon and explore cave churches, valleys and underground cities.
Walk across dazzling white travertine terraces and explore the ancient Greco-Roman city of Hierapolis.
Trace Istanbul's origins through the ancient city of Byzantium, later transformed into Constantinople and the heart of the Byzantine Empire.
Relax along the turquoise Mediterranean coast at Antalya, with its charming old town of Kaleiçi, ancient Roman harbour and nearby Düden Waterfalls.

groups.name: Oman
groups.tagline: 5 Nights, 6 Days · Muscat, Barka, Nizwa & Misfah Village, Wahiba Sands, Sur

offer.summary: 6 days trip built around Muscat, Barka, Nizwa & Misfah Village, Wahiba Sands, Sur at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Oman journeys we shape by hand through Oman, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you.
highlights: Discover grand mosques, the Royal Opera House and Muttrah Souq beside the serene Gulf of Oman.
Experience authentic coastal Oman through its historic fort, lively fish market and traditional souq culture.
Explore Nizwa Fort and Souq before wandering through Misfah's ancient mud-brick homes, terraces and falaj channels.
Cross rolling golden dunes by 4×4 or camel, then watch the desert glow beneath a star-filled sky.
Discover Oman's seafaring soul through its traditional dhow-building yards, coastal scenery and nearby turtle-watching shores.

groups.name: Jordan
groups.tagline: 7 Nights, 8 Days · Amman, Petra, Jerash, Ajloun, Madaba, Mt Nebo, Baptism Site, Dead Sea

offer.summary: 8 days trip built around Amman, Petra, Jerash, Ajloun, Madaba, Mt Nebo, Baptism Site, Dead Sea at your pace — no rushed coaches, no fixed groups. It's one of the Jordan journeys we shape by hand through Jordan, and every detail here is a starting point we'll tailor to you. Rate Valid for group of minimum 15 PAX travelling together
highlights: Discover the capital's ancient soul at the Citadel and Roman Theatre, surrounded by lively markets and modern city life.
Walk through the Siq to the magnificent Treasury, carved into Petra's rose-red sandstone cliffs.
Explore one of the world's best-preserved Roman cities, with grand columns, arches, plazas and ancient streets.
Visit the hilltop Ajloun Castle, a powerful medieval fortress overlooking Jordan's green northern landscapes.
Admire the famous sixth-century mosaic map of the Holy Land inside St. George's Church.
Stand where Moses is believed to have viewed the Promised Land, with sweeping Jordan Valley and Dead Sea panoramas.
Visit Bethany Beyond the Jordan, the sacred riverside site traditionally associated with the baptism of Jesus.
Float effortlessly in mineral-rich waters, enjoy therapeutic mud and unwind at the lowest point on Earth.
